newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha edges up with crude but buyers scarce.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha edges up with crude but buyers scarce.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices edged higher on the back of firmer crude on Friday, but discussion was very thin with buyers relaxed and many players away from there desks attending an industry gathering, traders said.

The cargo market saw some refiners offering small 5-10,000 tonne parcels at around $202 cif NWE and one trader was heard offering a late September loading Algerian cargo at a steady $205 cif in both NWE and Mediterranean.
Neither seller saw much buying interest with most petrochemical buyers reportedly having cover to the end of the month. --Colin Wooster, London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7456
